name: The Westin London City
positioning: The Westin London City: a wellness-focused hotel between the City of London and the River Thames, with a riverside bar, a spa with a pool, and suites and residences with St Paul's and Thames views
best_for: Business travelers who want a base in the City of London
Families or groups who want a three-bedroom residence with a kitchen

facts.text: The hotel overlooks Bankside and is a few minutes from the West End and South Bank.
Some rooms have views of St Paul's Cathedral.
The Presidential Suite has a private terrace facing the sunset over St Paul's.
Room interiors feature oak timber panelling, rich green hues and curved lines inspired by nature.
The fitness studio has Technogym bikes and equipment, TRX and a Hypervolt recovery station.
The Champagne bar is run in partnership with Taittinger and offers flight tastings with City views.
The hotel operates a cashless policy.
One dog up to 15 kilograms is welcome per room.

highlights.text: The Heavenly Spa by Westin has a swimming pool, steam room, sauna, sensorial shower, vitality pool and ice fountain.
Each residence has three bedrooms, a balcony overlooking the River Thames and a fully equipped kitchen.
The St Paul's Duplex Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows over two floors and a one-bedroom mezzanine.
The hotel sits between the City of London and the River Thames.
Hithe + Seek is a riverside bar and kitchen with unobstructed views across the River Thames.

considerations.text: None of the hotel rooms face the River Thames; the river view is from the Hithe + Seek wine bar.
The nearest public car park, NCP Thames Vintry, is about a 10-minute walk away.
WhataHotel notes the business district can be quieter on weekends.
